You: Has this gate always been here?
Vex: The stone is older than the towers. Look closely and you can see three generations of repairs. We keep the old blocks because they still do the job.
Torr: The city looks quiet from the hill. Down here, every cracked terminal has someone waiting on a spare part.
You: What is this slab used for?
Torr: It used to match shifts with maintenance crews. Today we leave notes for each other. Ask around the hill before you trust a blank screen.
Linn: Looking for someone? Try the shade. Sooner or later everyone comes up here, even the people who swear they are too busy.
You: Why does everyone meet here?
Linn: You can see the gate, hear the market, and get out of the dust. No terminal needs to explain that. If we get separated, meet me on the hill.
Mira: Welcome to Basic General. Fresh seals on the flasks, checked packs in the medkits. I can buy that scrap coil if you need a few credits.
You: Show me your stock.
Mira: Bought Water Flask for 4 credits.
Mira: Sold Scrap Coil for 1 credit.
Lattice Jack: Signal acquired. Opening the sector lattice.
Lattice Jack: Link established to Crosswind Reach.
Ring Gate: Destination offline. The far ring has gone quiet.
Warden Ossa: New scavenger? Nobody walks the Berms unarmed. I'm Ossa, on West Gate watch. Take the scrap pistol from the ARMS LOCKER under the canopy at my post; the cyan light marks it. Then use the range across the lane.
